f1bcc0f1be6294c99bc8e39e15067a7300fe09e6.caption: Four tables of typography core tokens, each with the columns Name, Value and Example. Family: family-display-title is STIHL Contraface Digital Display Title (example "AA"), family-text is STIHL Contraface Digital Text (example "Aa" in bold) and family-text-demi is STIHL Contraface Digital Text Demi (example "Aa"). Weight: weight-regular is Regular (examples "AA, Aa") and weight-bold is Bold (example "Aa"). Size: size-10 (10px), size-12 (12px), size-14 (14px), size-16 (16px), size-18 (18px), size-20 (20px), size-22 (22px), size-24 (24px), size-26 (26px) and size-30 (30px), with a light blue square growing with each value. Line height: line-height-16 (16px), line-height-20 (20px), line-height-24 (24px), line-height-28 (28px), line-height-32 (32px) and line-height-38 (38px), also with growing light blue squares.
